return_policy.general: You can return most items within 30 days of purchase for a full refund or exchange. Items must be in their original condition, with all tags and packaging intact. Please bring your receipt or proof of purchase when returning items.
return_policy.electronics: Electronics can be returned within 14 days of purchase with the original packaging and all accessories. Opened software, digital downloads, and video games cannot be returned unless defective.
return_policy.clothing: Clothing items can be returned within 30 days as long as they are unworn, unwashed, and have all original tags attached.
return_policy.exceptions: Certain items such as clearance merchandise, perishable goods, and personal care items are non-returnable. Please check the product description or ask a store associate for more details.

refund_policy.general: Refunds will be issued to the original form of payment. If you paid by credit card, the refund will be credited to your card. If you paid by cash or check, you will receive a cash refund.
refund_policy.processing_time: Credit card refunds typically take 3-5 business days to process. Debit card refunds may take 7-10 business days to appear in your account.
refund_policy.gift_cards: Purchases made with gift cards will be refunded to a new gift card.

shipping_policy.standard: Standard shipping (3-5 business days) is free on orders over $35. Orders under $35 have a flat rate shipping fee of $5.99.
shipping_policy.expedited: Expedited shipping (2 business days) is available for a flat rate of $12.99. Overnight shipping is available for $19.99.
shipping_policy.international: International shipping is available to select countries. Shipping rates vary by location and will be calculated at checkout.
